messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — I'm drafting an 'onboard readiness' checklist for new model entries. Need to lock the acceptance gates we'll require before GA: benchmarks, pin policy, migration runway, and comms. Starting this thread to collect constraints.

Ken (Eng): Suggest we require p99 latency targets on the standard dedicated config and a cost guardrail. Example: p99 < 500ms, avg token cost < $0.80 per 1M tokens (optimizable by quantization). Also a stability metric: <0.5% failure/invalid outputs on the eval suite.

Marta (SRE): Rollout constraints to add: canary on 2 production tenants for 14 days, telemetry retention for 30d for the canary window, and an automated fallback path that triggers on error budget depletion. Also include runbook hooks for oncall.

Diego (Prod): From customers: pin grace period of 90 days by default + an opt-in assisted migration for enterprise. We should require an embeddings compatibility shim for a migration path where vector schema changes.

Sofia (Support): Please include a customer-facing migration doc template and a rollback contact list (SE + AE + Ops). That reduces support churn during cutovers.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: #5132 "model-entry-readiness" — https://redwood/tickets/5132 — checklist placeholder added.

Ken (Eng): Proposed benchmark payload (example):
```json
{"samples":1000,"avg_latency_ms":120,"p99_latency_ms":480,"embed_cosine_diff":0.021,"error_rate":0.003}
```
We should require sample size >= 1k with multi-locale coverage for text models. For embed-only, a smaller sample is ok.

Aisha (PM): TL;DR so far: (1) perf gates: p99 <500ms on standard dedicated profile; (2) quality gates: eval A/B delta within defined margin and error_rate <0.5%; (3) rollout: 2-tenant canary for 2w + automated rollback; (4) pin policy: default 90d with exception process; (5) comms: migration playbook + customer template. Anything missing?

Marta (SRE): Monitoring addendum: token-level cost dashboards and an alert if cost per token deviates >20% during canary relative to baseline. Also require tracing hooks to tie latency regressions to specific kernel/quantization variants.

Diego (Prod): We also need a model variant matrix in the docs: performance profile for quantized vs full-precision, and guidance for customers on when to pick each variant.

Aisha (PM): For prioritization: Recommend classifying as 'High' priority for any model that meets either (a) >1% of platform usage impact, or (b) linked to an enterprise contract. Lower-impact models go to 'Standard' lane.

Sofia (Support): +1. Request a 'fast-path' checklist for small footprint models (embed-only or <200M params) with reduced gates to speed onboarding.

Ken (Eng): Fast-path idea: sample size 200, 48h canary, mandatory auto-fallback, and require basic perf and cost metrics. No full 30d telemetry retention on fast-path.

Aisha (PM): Great. I'll convert this into acceptance criteria in ticket #5132, assign owners (Ken for benchmarks, Marta for rollout/runbook, Diego for customer migration docs, Sofia for support template). Scheduling a short sync Friday 10:00am to finalize. :calendar:

Diego (Prod): One more ask — include a compatibility label in the catalog metadata (e.g., "embed-schema-stable", "vector-compat-v2") so we can automate migrations.

Aisha (PM): Noted — adding metadata fields to the checklist. Thanks everyone, closing thread for now; will post the updated ticket link once done. :thumbsup:
